blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We investigate two aspects of multilingual pre-training with limited data, namely how language exposure is distributed across English, Dutch, and Chinese, and how that exposure is ordered during training. In particular, we compare balanced multilingual exposure to language-dominant exposure, where one language is exposed with more training data than the others. We also compare mixed training, where multilingual training data is used throughout training, with curriculum training, where monolingual exposure of the dominant language is followed by balanced multilingual exposure. Our results show that multilingual BabyLM performance varies with both the amount and order of language exposure. Mixed training outperforms curriculum learning across all 15 matched configurations, indicating that simultaneous multilingual exposure is more effective than staged exposure in our setting. Several language-dominant mixed training configurations achieve higher scores than the balanced configuration, suggesting that a balanced distribution is not necessarily the highest-performing configuration in our setting. Interestingly, the Dutch-primary configurations achieve the best overall performance.
blocks.zh: 我们以有限的数据调查了多语种预训的两个方面,即语言接触如何在英语、荷兰语和汉语之间分布,以及在培训期间如何下令进行。 特别是,我们比较了多种语文均衡接触主要语言的情况,其中一种语言接触的培训数据多于其他语言。 我们还将混合培训与课程培训进行比较,在混合培训中,多语种培训数据在整个培训过程中都得到使用,在单一语言接触主语后,将均衡地接触多语种。 我们的结果显示,多种语言的婴儿LM性能随语言接触的大小和顺序而不同。 混合培训超越了所有15个匹配配置的课程学习,表明同时进行多语种接触比我们环境中的分阶段接触更有效。 几种语言主导混合训练组合的分数高于平衡组合,这表明均衡分布不一定是我们设定中表现最高的组合. 有趣的是,荷兰-初级组合取得了最佳的整体表现.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: While the performance of multilingual pre-trained models has improved over the recent years, billions of tokens are required to achieve these results. In the context of the BabyLM Challenge choshen2026babylmturns4goes , the focus lies on the learning abilities of language models from a limited amount of training data, thereby shifting attention from scaling pre-training toward efficient language learning. For the multilingual track, this brings attention to how data should be distributed among languages, as well as the order of language exposure.
blocks.zh: 虽然近年来多语种预训模型的性能有所改善,但要实现这些成果,需要数十亿令牌. 在BabyLM Challenge chosshen2026babylmturns4goes的背景下,重点是从有限的培训数据中学习语言模型的能力,从而将注意力从扩大预训转向高效的语言学习. 就多语种而言,这使人们注意到数据应如何在各语文之间分配,以及语言接触的顺序。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Mixed and curriculum training for the Dutch-primary 60/20/20 configuration. Mixed training shuffles all 100M tokens in a single stage, whereas curriculum training first uses 40M Dutch tokens and then a balanced multilingual stage containing 20M tokens from each language. For this configuration, mixed training achieves a higher multilingual average than curriculum training and produces the best overall result in our experiments.
blocks.zh: 图1:荷兰小学的620/20组合的混合和课程培训。 混合训练在单一阶段会洗涤出所有100M符号,而课程训练首先使用40M荷兰符号,然后是平衡的多语种舞台,包含来自每种语言的20M符号. 就这种组合而言,混合培训的多语种平均数高于课程培训,并在我们的实验中产生最佳的总体结果。

blocks.en: In this paper, we address these questions in a controlled setting of multilingual exposure with English, Dutch and Chinese. We compare balanced exposure among the three languages with a setup where one language is exposed more than others. We also compare two training schemes: mixed and curriculum training. In mixed training, the full multilingual dataset is used throughout training. In curriculum training, the same dataset is used, however split into two stages: the model first trains on a monolingual primary language subset, then continues on a balanced multilingual subset containing all three languages. Our contributions are:
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们用英语、荷兰语和中文在受控的多语种环境中讨论这些问题。 我们比较三种语言之间平衡的接触与一种语言比另一种语言暴露更多的结构。 我们还比较两个培训计划:混合培训和课程培训。 在混合培训中,整个培训中都使用完整的多语种数据集。 在课程培训中,使用相同的数据集,但又分为两个阶段:模式第一列列车在单一语言初级语言子集上,然后在包含所有三种语言的均衡多语言子集上继续. 我们的贡献是:

blocks.en: • We examine the effect of the amount of language exposure in multilingual BabyLM pre-training by comparing balanced exposure with language-dominant exposure across English, Dutch, and Chinese. • We explore the effect of exposure order by comparing mixed training with a two-stage curriculum learning strategy, in which monolingual primary language exposure is followed by balanced multilingual exposure. • We investigate whether strong overall multilingual performance requires balanced training by comparing settings where each language is dominant. A natural baseline for multilingual training is a balanced distribution across languages, however, our results show that this assumption does not hold in our setting 1 1 1 Code and experimental resources are available at https://github.com/jinx2321/babylm26 . .
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 我们审查多种语言的婴儿LM预训中语言接触量的影响,将平衡接触与英语、荷兰语和汉语语言占主导地位的接触相比较。 我们通过将混合培训与两阶段课程学习战略进行比较来探索接触顺序的效果,在两阶段课程学习战略中,单一语言初级语言接触之后是均衡的多语种接触。 我们通过比较每种语言占主导地位的场合,来调查强有力的整体多语种表现是否需要均衡的培训。 多语种培训的自然基线是各语文的均衡分布,但我们的结果显示,这一假设在我们设定11 1 准则时并不存在,实验资源可在https://github.com/jinx2321/babylm26上查阅。

blocks.en: We examine the effect of the amount of language exposure in multilingual BabyLM pre-training by comparing balanced exposure with language-dominant exposure across English, Dutch, and Chinese.
blocks.zh: 我们审查多语种婴儿LM预训中语言接触量的影响,将均衡接触与英语、荷兰语和汉语主要语言接触相比较。

blocks.en: We explore the effect of exposure order by comparing mixed training with a two-stage curriculum learning strategy, in which monolingual primary language exposure is followed by balanced multilingual exposure.
blocks.zh: 我们通过将混合培训与两阶段课程学习战略进行比较,探索接触顺序的效果,在两阶段课程学习战略中,单一语言初级语言接触之后,将平衡的多语种接触。

blocks.en: We investigate whether strong overall multilingual performance requires balanced training by comparing settings where each language is dominant.
blocks.zh: 我们通过比较每种语言占主导地位的场合,来调查强有力的整体多语种表现是否需要均衡的培训。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: One of the issues in multilingual learning is whether training should be balanced across different languages. Prior research on multilingual machine translation has demonstrated that the language sampling distribution has a considerable impact on overall performance. wang2020balancing show that learning how to rebalance training data across languages can improve performance across languages.
blocks.zh: 多种语文学习的问题之一是,培训是否应当在不同语文之间取得平衡。 以往对多语种机器翻译的研究表明,语言抽样分布对总体绩效有相当大的影响. Wang2020均衡显示,学习如何重新平衡不同语言的培训数据可以提高不同语言的性能.

blocks.en: Although balanced exposure to multiple languages serves as a natural baseline, previous work has shown that imbalance is occasionally beneficial for cross-lingual transfer. schafer2024role investigate controlled experiments using cloned languages that separate the effects of imbalance from linguistic factors. They show that the dominance of one language positively affects the performance of other minority languages and results in better cross-lingual alignment, an effect that is more prominent in larger models and with more training time. We address a similar problem using the BabyLM framework but with real languages.
blocks.zh: 虽然平衡接触多种语言是自然的基准,但以前的工作表明,不平衡有时有利于跨语言的转移。 schafer2024 role调查使用克隆语言的可控实验,这些实验将不平衡的影响与语言因素区分开来. 它们表明,一种语言的主导地位对其他少数群体语言的绩效产生积极的影响,并导致更好的跨语言相配合,这种影响在更大的模式中更为突出,培训时间也更长。 我们用BabyLM框架处理一个类似的问题,但使用真实的语言。

blocks.en: bengio2009curriculum introduced curriculum learning, which sorts training examples in a meaningful order, from simple to complex or from one domain to another, in order to boost learning efficiency. In the case of multilingual settings, the ordering may define the moment the model forms shared multilingual representations early or first specializes in one language. Previous research on few-shot cross-lingual transfer has demonstrated that the mixed multilingual training procedure outperforms staged target adaptation xu2022que .
blocks.zh: Bengio2009 Curriculum引入了课程学习,将培训实例按有意义的顺序分类,从简单到复杂或从一个领域到另一个领域,以提高学习效率。 对于多语种的设置,顺序可以定义模型早期形成共享多语种代表或最初专门使用一种语言的时刻. 以往关于少发多语种转接的研究表明,混合多语种培训程序的表现超过了Xu2022que的目标适应。

blocks.en: Our comparison between mixed and curriculum training is also motivated by bilingual language acquisition, in which both the amount of exposure and the time at which that exposure takes place are important. A distinction is made between simultaneous bilingual language acquisition, in which more than one language is learned from an early age, and sequential bilingual language acquisition, in which another language is acquired later johnson1989critical . Although our experimental setup cannot be considered as direct representations of bilinguals, this distinction provides a useful motivation for comparing simultaneous multilingual exposure with staged curriculum learning.
blocks.zh: 我们比较混合培训与课程培训的另一个动机是掌握双语语言,在双语语言中,接触的数量和时间都很重要。 区分了同时获得双语语言(从小学会一种以上语言)和相继获得双语语言(后来获得另一种语言Johnson-1989 Critical ). 虽然我们的实验设置不能被视为双语的直接表现,但这种区分为将同时使用多语种与分阶段课程学习进行比较提供了有益的动力。

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: The detailed training setup can be found in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 详细的培训设置见附录A。

blocks.en: 3.1 Data
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据

blocks.en: The training corpus is constructed from Wikipedia dumps 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/datasets/wikimedia/wikipedia for the three languages: English, Dutch, and Chinese in the BabyLM 2026 multilingual track. Wikipedia dumps are used in order to keep the source domain as comparable as possible across the languages, since the BabyLM corpora contain different mixtures of domains. As per the constraint of the track, each configuration contains 100M tokens, where the number of tokens is calculated based on the byte premium arnett2024bit of each language.
blocks.zh: 训练大纲由维基百科中的相关条目: Diggingface 2 2 https://huggingface.co/datasets/wikimedia/wikipedia 为三种语言所建:英语,荷兰语,以及BabyLM 2026多语种音轨中的中文. 使用维基百科垃圾堆是为了尽可能保持源域在各语言之间的可比性,因为BabyLM corpora包含不同域的混合物. 根据音轨的制约,每个配置包含100M个令牌,其中令牌的数量根据每种语言的字节溢价arnett2024bit来计算.

blocks.en: We use six data configurations, where each configuration has different proportions allocated to each language. The baseline configuration contains an equal number of tokens in all three languages. The five language-dominant configurations allocate the primary language with a higher percentage while the rest is divided equally among the other two languages. We have chosen primary language percentages of 50%, 60%, 70%, 80%, and 90%, resulting in five different configurations as shown in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 我们使用6个数据配置,其中每个配置对每种语言分配的比例不同. 基线配置包含所有三种语言的等号符. 5个语言主体配置分配主语的比例较高,而其余则在另外两种语言中平均分配. 我们选择了50%、60%、70%、80%和90%的初级语言百分比,因此如表1所示,有五个不同的组合。

blocks.en:
Table 1: Data proportion configurations. Each language-dominant
configuration is instantiated with English, Dutch, and Chinese as the
primary language respectively.
blocks.zh:
表1:数据比例配置. 每个语言主体
配置以英语、荷兰语和中文作为即时

blocks.en: For each language-dominant split and primary-language pairing, we generate two further subsets for curriculum training (see Section 3.3 ): a Stage 1 subset containing only primary-language text and a Stage 2 subset containing the remaining primary-language text together with all non-primary-language text, shuffled randomly. The split is constructed so that each language contributes an equal number of tokens in Stage 2. For instance, in the 60/20/20 configuration, Stage 1 contains 40M tokens from the primary language, while Stage 2 contains the remaining 60M tokens, with 20M tokens from each language, as shown in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh: 对于每种语言占主导地位的分词和初等语言配对,我们再产生两个子集用于课程培训(见第3.3节):第一阶段子集只包含初等语言文本;第二阶段子集包含其余的初等语言文本以及所有非初等语言文本,随机打乱。 分拆的构造使得每种语言在第二阶段贡献了等同数量的符. 例如,在60/20/20配置中,第1阶段包含来自初级语言的40M个令牌,而第2阶段包含剩余的60M个令牌,其中来自每种语言的20M个令牌如图1所示.

blocks.en: 3.2 Model
blocks.zh: 3.2 模式

blocks.en: We train a decoder-only transformer from scratch using the Qwen3 architecture yang2025qwen3 , which results in ca. 110M parameters (768 hidden dimension, 12 layers, 12 attention heads, 2048 feed-forward dimension, 1024 context length). We train a separate byte-level BPE tokenizer for each data configuration, using the training data of the configuration as the corpus for tokenization. This guarantees that the language distribution utilized for tokenization is equal to the distribution seen during the pre-training process.
blocks.zh: 我们使用 Quen3 架构 yang2025qwen3 从零开始训练一个解码器的变压器,它得出 ca. 110M 参数 (768 隐藏维度, 12层, 12个注意力头, 2048 feed-forward 维度, 1024上下文长度). 我们为每个数据配置培训一个单独的字节级BPE标识器,使用配置的培训数据作为标识符。 这保证了用于象征性的语文分配与培训前的分发相等。

blocks.en: 3.3 Training Strategies and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.3 培训战略和评价

blocks.en: We compare the mixed and curriculum learning strategies across all five language-dominant configurations, as shown in Figure 1 . In mixed training, all 100M tokens from the corpus are shuffled in random order and used during the 10-epoch training. The model is exposed to all three languages throughout all training iterations. Curriculum training involves two consecutive training stages using the Stage 1 and Stage 2 subsets from Section 3.1 . In Stage 1, the model trains on the subset that contains only the primary language for 10 epochs, and then Stage 2 continues training on the multilingual balanced subset for another 10 epochs, initialized from the Stage 1 checkpoint, including the optimizer and learning rate scheduler states. Stage 1 and Stage 2 together cover the whole 100M-token dataset configuration. Thus, each language is seen the same number of times across both strategies and only the order of exposure differs.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,我们比较了所有五个语言主体组合的混合和课程学习战略。 在混合训练中,所有100M从官能团得到的标志被随机地洗牌并用于10世纪的训练. 该模型在所有培训迭代中都接触了所有三种语言。 课程培训包括两个连续的培训阶段,使用第3.1节的第一阶段和第二阶段子集。 在第1阶段,只包含10个纪元主要语言的子集上的模型列车,然后第2阶段继续培训另外10个纪元的多语种均衡子集,从第1阶段检查站初始化,包括优化器和学习速率调度器状态. 第1阶段和第2阶段一起涵盖整个100M-token数据集配置. 因此,在两种战略中,每种语言的接触次数相同,只有接触顺序不同。

blocks.en: For all models, the official BabyLM evaluation pipeline choshen2026babylmturns4goes was used for evaluation, which contains zero-shot and fine-tuning tasks in English, Dutch, and Chinese. The zero-shot tasks include BLiMP warstadt2020blimp , GlobalPIQA chang2025global , HellaSwag zellers2019hellaswag , MultiBLiMP jumelet2026multiblimp , Winogrande sakaguchi2021winogrande , XStoryCloze lin2022few , and XCOMPS he2025xcomps , while fine-tuning evaluation cover tasks such as ARC clark2018think , Belebele bandarkar2024belebele , BMLAMA qi2023cross , MNLI williams2018broad , SIB-200 adelani2024sib , TruthfulQA lin2022truthfulqa , XNLI conneau2018xnli , and INCLUDE romanou2025include . The zero-shot average, fine-tuning average, and overall average scores of each language are reported for all models.
blocks.zh: 对于所有模型来说,官方的BabyLM评价管道choshen2026babylmturns4goes被用于评价,其中包含英语,荷兰语和汉语的零镜头和微调任务. 0射出的任务包括: BLIMP warstadt2020blimp , GlobalPIQA chang2025 Global , HellaSwag sellers2019hellaswag , MultiBLIMP jumelet2026 multiblimp , Winogrande sakaguchi2021winogrande , XStoryCloze lin2022few,和 XCOMPS he2025xcompals , 同时微调评价的任务包括ARC Clark2018think, Belebele bandarkar2024bebele , BMLIMA qi2023 Cross , MNLI Williams2018broad, SI-200 aIB-delani2024sib, TruthfulQA lin2022rempfulqa, XNLI Coneau18xnli和INCLUDE roman-2025inc。 所有模型都报告每种语言的零射入平均值、微调平均值和总体平均分。

blocks.en: 4 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 4 结果和讨论

blocks.en: The full results can be found in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 全部结果见附录B。

blocks.en: 4.1 Impact of Language Exposure Proportion
blocks.zh: 4.1 语言接触比例的影响

blocks.en: Figure 2: Multilingual average performance across primary-language data proportions, grouped by the language designated as primary and by training strategy. Each point averages performance across English, Dutch, and Chinese, while the dashed horizontal line marks the balanced 33/33/33 baseline.
blocks.zh: 图 2:按指定为初级语言的语言和培训战略分类的多语种平均表现。 每点平均表现跨越英语,荷兰语和汉语,而虚线水平线则标志着平衡的33/33/33基线.

blocks.en: We analyze the effect of language exposure from two complementary perspectives. Figure 2 compares complete data-allocation configurations using their multilingual average, showing whether language-dominant exposure improves overall performance relative to the balanced baseline. Figure 3 instead examines each language separately by relating its proportion in the training data to performance in that same language.
blocks.zh: 我们从两个互补的角度分析语言接触的影响。 图2用其多语种平均数比较了完整的数据分配配置,显示语文主导曝光度相对于平衡基线而言是否改善了总体性能. 相反,图3通过将其在培训数据中的比例与使用同一语言的业绩挂钩,分别审查每种语文。

blocks.en: We first compare the language-dominant configurations with the balanced 33/33/33 mixed training baseline, which obtains a multilingual average of 46.23. For English-primary mixed training, the 70/15/15 and 80/10/10 configurations outperform the balanced baseline, with performance peaking at 46.51 for 80/10/10.
blocks.zh: 我们首先将语文主导组合与平衡的33/33/33混合培训基线进行比较,后者平均获得46.23个多语种。 就英语-初级混合培训而言,70/15/15和80/10/10的组合超过了平衡基线,表现最高,80/10/10达到46.51。

blocks.en: Dutch-primary mixed training performs more consistently: all five Dutch-primary configurations outperform the balanced baseline. The highest multilingual average is 46.67 at 60/20/20, an improvement of 0.44 points over the baseline and the best overall result among all configurations. Chinese-primary training provides smaller benefits. The 50/25/25 and 60/20/20 configurations slightly exceed the baseline, reaching a maximum of 46.33 at 60/20/20, whereas configurations with higher Chinese proportions fall below it.
blocks.zh: 荷兰-小学混合培训的执行情况更加一致:所有五个荷兰-小学组合都超过了平衡的基准。 在60/20/20年度,多语种的平均数最高为46.67个,比基线提高了0.44分,是所有组合中总体最佳结果。 中小学教育提供较少的福利。 50/25和60/20/20的配置略高于基线,在60/20/20时达到最多46.33个,而中国比例较高的配置则低于基线。

blocks.en: These comparisons show that the balanced configuration is not the highest-scoring configuration in this setting, although the benefit of language dominance depends on both the primary language and the degree of imbalance. English-primary performance peaks at 80/10/10, while Dutch-primary and Chinese-primary performance peak at 60/20/20. At 90/5/5, only the Dutch-primary model remains above the balanced baseline, indicating that extreme imbalance is generally less effective.
blocks.zh: 这些比较表明,平衡配置在此设置中并不是得分最高的配置,尽管语言优势的优势既取决于主语,也取决于不平衡的程度. 英语小学的表演高峰为80/10;而荷兰语小学和中语小学的表演高峰为620/20. 在2005年5月90日时,只有荷兰-初级模式仍然高于平衡的基准,这表明极端失衡一般不太有效。

blocks.en: This finding is important since a balanced distribution is a natural baseline when all three evaluation languages are weighted equally. Nevertheless, for each primary language, at least one language-dominant mixed training configuration outperforms the balanced model. The advantage is therefore not limited to English dominance as the Dutch-primary 60/20/20 configuration achieves the best overall result, while the Chinese-primary 50/25/25 and 60/20/20 configurations also surpass the balanced baseline. At the same time, the weaker results under the most extreme allocations suggest a trade-off between increasing exposure to the primary language and maintaining sufficient exposure to the other languages.
blocks.zh: 这一结论很重要,因为均衡分布是所有三种评价语文都得到同等加权的自然基线。 尽管如此,对于每种初级语言,至少有一种语言占主导地位的混合培训组合超过了平衡模式。 因此,这一优势并不限于英语主导地位,因为荷兰语-初级第60/20/20组合取得了最佳的整体结果,而中初级第50/25和60/20/20组合也超过了平衡基线。 同时,在最极端的分配下,结果较弱,这表明在增加接触主要语言和保持充分接触其他语言之间是一种取舍。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Relationship between language-specific data proportion and evaluation performance. Columns show English, Dutch, and Chinese data proportions, while rows show zero-shot, finetuned, and overall average performance for each language. Dashed lines indicate linear trends across all models, with R 2 R^{2} reported in each panel. The black square represents the balanced 33/33/33 baseline.
blocks.zh: 图3:特定语文的数据比例与评价业绩之间的关系。 各栏显示英语,荷兰语和汉语数据比例,而各行显示为零发,微调,并显示每种语言的总体平均性能. 虚线表示所有模型的线性趋势,每个面板报告R 2 R^{2}。 黑色广场代表平衡的33/33/33基线.

blocks.en: 4.2 Mixed vs. Curriculum Learning
blocks.zh: 4.2 混合课程学习

blocks.en: Next, we compare mixed training with the curriculum learning strategy. As shown in Figure 2 , mixed training achieves a higher multilingual average than curriculum training in all 15 matched language-dominant configurations. The difference is generally larger at high levels of dominance, although it does not increase monotonically. For example, at 80/10/10, mixed training outperforms curriculum training by 3.29 points in the English-primary setting and by 2.66 points in the Dutch-primary setting.
blocks.zh: 接着,我们将混合培训与课程学习战略进行比较。 如图2所显示,混合培训在所有15个对应语言主语组合的课程培训中实现了更高的平均多语种培训。 在高度的支配地位下,这种差别一般更大,尽管并不单调地增加。 例如,在10月80日,混合培训在英语小学课程培训中比3.29分,荷兰语小学课程培训中比2.66分。

blocks.en: The major weakness of curriculum training is its decline in performance of non-primary languages under high dominance conditions. In the English-primary 80/10/10 case, the Dutch and Chinese average scores of mixed training models are 46.59 and 44.42, respectively, whereas the corresponding figures for curriculum models are 40.81 and 40.19. This suggests that the large monolingual first stage encourages specialization on the primary language, and the subsequent multilingual stage does not fully compensate for this, consistent with findings that simultaneous multilingual exposure outperforms staged adaptation xu2022que .
blocks.zh: 课程培训的主要弱点是在高支配地位条件下非小学语言的成绩下降。 在英语小学80/10/10案中,荷兰和中国混合培训模式的平均分数分别为46.59分和44.42分,而课程模式的相应数字为40.81分和40.19分. 这说明,大型单一语言第一阶段鼓励初级语言的专业化,随后的多语言阶段不能完全弥补这一点,这与同时期多语言接触的表现超过适应xu2022que的结论是一致的.

blocks.en: 4.3 Language-Specific Effects of Exposure
blocks.zh: 4.3 接触的特定语言影响

blocks.en: Concerning the language-specific results in Figure 3 , the clearest relationship between data proportion and performance appears in zero-shot evaluation. The linear trends are positive for all three languages, with R 2 R^{2} values of 0.504 for English, 0.502 for Dutch, and 0.516 for Chinese. These similar values indicate that the proportion of a language in the pre-training data has a moderate relationship with zero-shot performance in that same language.
blocks.zh: 关于图3中具体语文的成果,数据比例与业绩之间的最明确关系出现在零镜头评价中。 所有三种语言的线性趋势都是正的,R 2 R^{2}的值为:英语为0.504;荷兰语为0.502;汉语为0.516. 这些相类似的数值表明,一种语言在预训数据中的比例与同一种语言的零发性能有中度关系.

blocks.en: The relationship is weaker for finetuned performance. English and Dutch show similar R 2 R^{2} values of 0.369 and 0.367, respectively, whereas the relationship is much weaker for Chinese, with R 2 = 0.140 R^{2}=0.140 . This difference is also visible in the trend lines as English and Dutch finetuned performance generally increases with additional same-language exposure, while Chinese finetuned scores vary less consistently with the proportion of Chinese data.
blocks.zh: 对于细化的性能来说,这种关系比较弱. 英语和荷兰语分别显示相近的R 2 R^{2}值为0.369和0.367,而中文的关系则要弱得多,R 2 = 0140 R^{2}=0.140. 这一差异在趋势线上也很明显,因为英语和荷兰语的微调性能一般随着额外的同语言曝光而增加,而中文的微调分数则与中文数据的比例相差不大.

blocks.en: The language-specific overall averages combine the zero-shot and finetuned results. The relationship is strongest for Dutch ( R 2 = 0.483 R^{2}=0.483 ), followed by English ( R 2 = 0.451 R^{2}=0.451 ), and is weaker for Chinese ( R 2 = 0.276 R^{2}=0.276 ). Overall, Figure 3 shows that same-language data proportion is most consistently related to zero-shot performance. The dispersion around the trend lines also shows that data proportion alone does not fully account for the differences among configurations.
blocks.zh: 语言特异性的整体平均值结合了零发和微调的结果. 关系最强的是荷兰语(R 2 = 0.483 R^{2}=0.483),其次是英语(R 2 = 0.451 R^{2}=0.451),而汉语(R 2 = 0.276 R^{2}=0.276)则较弱. 总体而言,图3显示同语数据比例与零发性能关系最一致. 趋势线周围的分散还表明,仅靠数据比例并不能充分说明不同配置之间的差异。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Our work studies the impact of language distributions and order of exposure on BabyLM multilingual pre-training with English, Dutch, and Chinese on a 100M-token budget. By comparing balanced and language-dominant data distributions with mixed and curriculum training strategies, we examined how both the amount and order of multilingual exposure shape evaluation performance.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作研究了语言分布和接触顺序对英语、荷兰语和汉语的BabyLM语言预训对100M-token预算的影响。 通过比较平衡和以语言为主的数据分布与混合和课程培训战略,我们审查了多语种接触的数量和顺序如何形成评价业绩。

blocks.en: We find that mixed training outperforms curriculum learning. Although the size of the difference does not increase monotonically, the gap is generally larger under highly imbalanced allocations, where curriculum training shows substantial declines in non-primary-language performance. Hence, simultaneous multilingual training should be preferred to sequential monolingual specialization and multilingual adaptation.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,这种混合培训比课程学习要好。 虽然差异的大小并不单调地增加,但是在分配严重不平衡的情况下,差距一般更大,课程培训显示非小学语言的成绩显著下降。 因此,应选择同时进行多语种培训,而不是相继进行单一语言专业和多语种调整。

blocks.en: In addition, perhaps more surprisingly, pre-training on balanced data is not the optimal approach in our experiments. For mixed training, even though we consider a balanced configuration as the baseline, a certain level of imbalance in favor of one language improves the performance of all three primary languages, suggesting that the effect of imbalance is not language-specific. However, the advantage decreases for extremely large imbalances, indicating a trade-off between strengthening the dominant language and preserving cross-lingual coverage. However, since we evaluate multiple language-dominant configurations against a single balanced configuration and conduct only one run per setting, these results should be interpreted descriptively rather than as evidence that imbalanced training is generally preferable to balanced training.
blocks.zh: 此外,也许更令人惊讶的是,关于平衡数据的预先培训不是我们实验中的最佳方法。 对于混合训练,虽然我们把均衡的配置作为基线,但某种程度的偏好一种语言的不平衡会改善所有三种初级语言的性能,说明不平衡的效果并不是针对语言的. 然而,这种优势因极其严重的不平衡而减弱,表明加强主要语言和保留跨语言的覆盖面之间有取舍。 然而,由于我们对照单一均衡的配置来评价多种语文主导组合,每场比赛只进行一跑,因此这些结果应作描述性解释,而不是作为培训不平衡一般优于均衡培训的证据。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our study is limited to only three languages (English, Dutch, and Chinese) within one domain (Wikipedia), thus it is uncertain whether our findings will apply to other languages or domains. All experiments use a fixed size of 100M tokens and a single model architecture (Qwen3). Results may vary for other scales and other architectures. The training procedure uses a separate tokenizer for every experiment based on the particular training dataset. Hence, some variations may be due to tokenizer settings in addition to differences in the data distribution. However, this choice was made in order to ensure that the language distribution for tokenization and model pre-training is the same. Moreover, due to limited computational resources, we conduct only one training procedure per configuration with a fixed random seed. Therefore, we do not estimate variance across training runs. The curriculum learning strategy we explore is applied using a fixed protocol with two stages, thus different protocols such as gradual mixing or additional stages may produce different results.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究仅限于一个域(Wikipedia)范围内的三种语言(英语,荷兰语,和汉语),因此我们的研究结论是否会适用于其他语言或域尚不确定. 所有实验都使用100M令牌的固定尺寸和单一模型架构(Quen3). 其他规模和其他结构的结果可能有所不同。 培训程序根据特定培训数据集,为每次实验使用单独的标注器. 因此,除了数据分布的差异外,还可能由于标致器设置而出现一些变化。 然而,作出这一选择是为了确保象征性的语文分布和模式的预训相同。 此外,由于计算资源有限,我们每个配置只进行一次培训,有固定的随机种子。 因此,我们并不估计各个培训项目的差异。 我们探索的课程学习策略采用固定的规程,分两个阶段实施,因此不同规程如相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相
